{{Quote|I want to hear him scream.|Rathari on Baras|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Rathari''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Rathari was given dispensation by the [[Dark Council]] to oversee Imperial operations on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], where the Empire was vying for the favor of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]]. At the same time, one of Rathari's rival's, [[Darth Baras]]' had one of his agents, [[Dellocon]], defect to join Rathari. Baras dispatched his [[Empire's Wrath|new]] [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] to eliminate Dellocon due to the danger of his network of spies being exposed.

[[File:Dellocon_death.png|thumb|left|160px|Rathari kills Dellocon.]]
With the assistance of another of Baras' operatives, [[Halidrell Setsyn]], the [[Sith Warrior]] began systemically interfering with Rathari's operations, including the destruction of his apprentice, [[Girik]], interrupting negotiations with the Hutts, and disrupting an Imperial assault on Republic holdings. Rathari struck back, tracking down Setsyn and killing her, before demanding that the Warrior face him in the [[Network Access]].

{{GameDS}}
The Warrior walked into an obvious trap, as Rathari unleashed his specialized hit squad to kill the Warrior. But he underestimated his opponent and was beaten in the subsequent lightsaber duel. Conceding defeat, Rathari then executed Dellocon, before confessing his belief that Baras would fall to his own apprentice. He offered his services to the Warrior, to wait for the day when he would witness Baras' downfall. The Warrior refused and struck down Rathari.

==Personality and traits==
As opposed to Baras, Rathari preferred direct, open actions rather than plotting from the shadows.

==Behind the scenes==
Depending on the player's choice, Rathari can either be killed (dark side dialogue), his services accepted, or spared and told to disappear (light side dialogue). If made to swear loyalty to Warrior, he later reappears during the Wrath's final confrontation with Baras on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]].
